author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
We are required to take some introduction to AI training.

I end up spending more time building an AI agent to take the training for me than I would have to just sit through that boring training as a human.

We are living in a weird world.

Note: technically, I am building a tool to help me take notes while I am taking the training so I can learn better.  It is a just a side effect that I can mute the browser.
